answer: Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the horizon of the next round. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The wharf of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
